content.text: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation exists anywhere in this consortium agreement; the only "exclusive" reference is the sole-and-exclusive-remedy language in the dispute clause (GOVLAW territory), and the capacity clauses expressly confirm freedom "without any restrictions."

input.quote: 12.22 Notwithstanding any other provisions in this Paragraph 12, when the Equipped Capacity is expanded to six (6) times of Initial Equipped Capacity or three (3) years after the RFS date whichever comes first, any Party is entitled to make available any of its Allocated Capacity for use by other Carriers on any commercial basis without any restrictions.
input.rationale: This is an APCN 2 consortium construction, ownership and maintenance agreement, and it imposes no exclusivity, sole-supplier or requirements-purchasing obligation on Teleglobe USA Inc. Searches for "exclusive", "exclusivity", "sole supplier", "purchase/procure/supply", "compete" and third-party restriction language turned up no responsive covenant: the Wet Segment is procured collectively through the Supply Contract placed by the Procurement Group (p0120), which is a joint procurement mechanic rather than an obligation on us to source from a counterparty. The capacity clauses run in our favour, expressly confirming that any Party may sell IRU or make its Allocated Capacity available to other Carriers "without any restrictions" (p0206, p0208); the intra-consortium conditions in Paragraph 12/Annex 7 govern disposition of our own allocated capacity and relax over time, and are not a restraint on buying from other suppliers. The only "exclusive" hit is the "sole and exclusive remedy" language in the dispute-resolution clause (p0262), which is a forum/remedy term reviewed under GOVLAW and is not a restrictive covenant. The agreement therefore sits at the preferred position (no exclusivity obligation on us), so no redline is proposed.
